days.title: What Makes Us Human - The Unique Gifts of Humanity
days.learning_objective: Celebrate the qualities that define humanity and remain beyond AI's reach.

days.title: Consciousness - Awareness and Experience
days.learning_objective: Explore the mystery of consciousness—subjective experience that AI does not possess.

days.title: Emotions - Feeling as Knowing
days.learning_objective: Understand emotions as a form of intelligence that guides decisions and creates meaning.

days.title: Empathy - Understanding Others' Feelings
days.learning_objective: Develop empathy as the uniquely human capacity to feel with and for others.

days.title: Intuition - Knowing Without Knowing How
days.learning_objective: Appreciate intuition as embodied knowledge that complements rational analysis.

days.title: Wisdom - Knowing What Matters
days.learning_objective: Distinguish wisdom from knowledge—the ability to apply understanding to what truly matters.

days.title: Purpose - Finding Meaning
days.learning_objective: Explore the human need for purpose and meaning that AI cannot experience or provide.

days.title: Values - What You Believe In
days.learning_objective: Clarify personal values as the foundation for a meaningful life and ethical action.

days.title: Embodiment - Having a Body
days.learning_objective: Appreciate the body as source of knowledge, experience, and being in the world.

days.title: Senses - The Five (and More) Ways We Perceive
days.learning_objective: Explore the richness of sensory experience that connects us to reality.

days.title: Movement - Physical Intelligence
days.learning_objective: Recognize physical movement as a form of intelligence and knowing.

days.title: Health - Caring for Your Body
days.learning_objective: Connect physical health to learning capacity and overall well-being.

days.title: Relationships - Human Connection
days.learning_objective: Celebrate relationships as the foundation of human flourishing and meaning.

days.title: Love - The Deepest Connection
days.learning_objective: Explore love as the most profound human capacity—irreplaceable by any technology.

days.title: Belonging - Being Part of Something
days.learning_objective: Understand the human need for belonging and community connection.

days.title: Identity - Who You Are
days.learning_objective: Explore the development and expression of personal identity.

days.title: Culture - Shared Meaning
days.learning_objective: Appreciate culture as the shared meanings, practices, and values that connect humans.

days.title: History - Learning from the Past
days.learning_objective: Value historical understanding as essential context for present wisdom.

days.title: Stories - Narrative Understanding
days.learning_objective: Recognize storytelling as a fundamental human way of making meaning.

days.title: Art - Human Expression
days.learning_objective: Appreciate art as uniquely human expression of experience, emotion, and meaning.

days.title: Play - Joy and Exploration
days.learning_objective: Embrace play as essential to learning, creativity, and human flourishing.

days.title: Humor - Laughter and Perspective
days.learning_objective: Appreciate humor as a uniquely human capacity that creates connection and perspective.

days.title: Spirituality - Transcendent Experience
days.learning_objective: Explore spiritual experience as a dimension of human life beyond material existence.

days.title: Nature Connection - Relationship with the Living World
days.learning_objective: Develop connection to nature as essential for human well-being and wisdom.

days.title: Time Perception - Experiencing Past, Present, Future
days.learning_objective: Explore the human experience of time and its role in meaning-making.

days.title: Mortality - Knowing Life Is Finite
days.learning_objective: Reflect on mortality as what gives life urgency and meaning.

days.title: Legacy - What You Leave Behind
days.learning_objective: Consider the legacy you want to leave and how you want to be remembered.

days.title: Growth - Continuous Development
days.learning_objective: Commit to continuous growth and development throughout life.

days.title: Human Potential - What We're Capable Of
days.learning_objective: Explore the vast potential of human capability waiting to be developed.

days.title: Month in Review - Celebrating Humanity
days.learning_objective: Synthesize appreciation for uniquely human capabilities as foundation for AI-age flourishing.
